#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

void processInput(int w, int m) {
    if (w < 4) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return;
    }
    
    for (; m > 0; ) {
        int remainder = m % w;
        if (remainder > 1 && remainder != w - 1) {
            cout << "NO" << endl;
            return;
        }
        m = (m + 1) / w;
    }
    
    cout << "YES" << endl;
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    
    processInput(w, m);
    
    return 0;
}
